prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: vehicle.model-14 reusable cargo rocket, isolated axially symmetric ENGINE EXHAUST EFFECT, animation FRAME0. Brand new original effect artwork, no input images. This is a genuine original raster part for a chunky classic isometric Tycoon transport-game sprite, later composited BEHIND an already approved unchanged rocket hull.

Create ONE compact vertical rocket-engine flame plume, downward on screen. The TOP emission plane is a clean horizontal oval/ellipse, WIDTH TO HEIGHT2:1, viewed with ORTHOGRAPHIC camera30degree ELEVATION above the horizontal plane. This top oval is pure luminous flame/gas, NOT a metal ring/nozzle/engine or separate object. Below this one elliptical mouth, the flame swells very slightly then tapers to ONE rounded/tiny pointed lower tip. Axially symmetric physical emitter: same cylindrical nozzle part can be used under any genuine yaw of an upright rocket. Vertical centerline fixed. No thrust angled left/right. Mouth-to-tip length approximately1.25times the mouth WIDTH, compact and sturdy rather than a very long missile trail. Whole silhouette width roughly the mouth width, with at most a small central bulge. Frame0 is the longer/narrower pulse of a later two-frame engine animation.

Materials/style: broad SIMPLE readable warm pale-YELLOW/cream core, muted golden-orange outer flame, restrained dark-orange thin perimeter where useful. Rounded chunky low-detail stylized3D game effect, matte-like simple material regions and controlled soft shading; avoid photoreal fire detail. The emission itself is luminous, with color contained INSIDE the physical flame alpha, no surrounding bloom/halo/fog. Keep high enough alpha through the main body to survive reduction to about8pixels mouth width and11pixels mouth-to-tip length in a fixed64x48 sprite. No thin flying sparks, separate droplets, smoke, shock-diamond chain, multiple tails, debris, purple/magenta, labels or decorative filigree. A small amount of clean anti-aliasing is fine; no vast faint halo. Fixed screen lighting appropriate for an upright orthographic2:1 game view; emission planes and curved gas have consistent3D form.

Composition: ONE WHOLE complete effect centered on a square1024x1024 genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA canvas. Top emission-mouth center about(512,300); mouth width roughly400pixels, ellipse height200pixels, lower tip near y800. Every visible/faint flame edge remains within approximately[260,170]-[770,850], with at least140pixels TRUE TRANSPARENT clearance on EVERY side. The exact requested canvas is only a source layout; generous complete-alpha clearance matters more than size. Keep the actual mouth center and complete tip easy to identify for uniform scaling/registration. Do not draw a marker or reference dot.

NO rocket hull, metal nozzle/bell/rim, landing legs/feet, platform, ground/floor/road/rail/water, cast ground shadow, backdrop, extra model/view/frame, scenery, person, cargo/probe/pod, text/label/number/logo/arrow/guide/cross/colored bounding box/magenta separator. Output only the single physical downward engine flame with clean real alpha, no external background. Native part envelope and unchanged hull will be validated later; do not add hardware.

model_review.reason: Visible luminous emitter ellipse is approximately5:1 rather than the declared2:1 horizontal circular plane at30degree camera elevation. Tail is also longer than the requested compact pulse. Whole alpha is retained; no flattening/warp/crop rescue. Correct through a genuine new ImageGen edit with explicit geometry reference.
